text:
I tested eight of the nine pages with the Trusted Tester tools, and the results are partial. The tool that checks the missions page was still running when I wrote this, so every criterion for that page is NEEDS_REVIEW. For the NACA at 110 page, the run hit its time limit. Only 3.2.3 finished there.

I did not answer the tool's open judgment questions. That includes focus order, visible labels, and whether links are named consistently. Those criteria stay NEEDS_REVIEW unless the tool reached a result on its own. The same applies to error identification and suggestion, because the tool can't see what the server replies. The multiple-ways check also stays NEEDS_REVIEW because I didn't run it with the home and sitemap pages added.

**What failed**
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks:** this fails on every page where the check finished: search, spot-the-station, the NSSC form, careers, Artemis III, the news release and the gallery. The shared header begins with the "Explore", "News & Events" and "Multimedia" buttons and has no skip link.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible:** four pages have elements that show no focus change.
  - **Spot the Station:** "Hide player controls" and "NASA Johnson".
  - **Careers:** "Read More".
  - **Artemis III:** "NASA", "Hide player controls" and "More NASA News".
  - **News release:** the "Looking up, three white and black fighter jets…" image link.
  - Other elements on these pages and on the gallery were flagged for a person to check.
- **2.4.3 Focus Order:** on the careers page, Tab and Shift+Tab move focus out of the "Internships" dialog onto the page behind it.

**Other notes**
- Spot the Station's "Country:" list and its embedded content could not be checked automatically, so keyboard access there is NEEDS_REVIEW.
- The tool reported 3.3.4 as not applicable for the NSSC accounts-receivable form. It is a financial request, so I marked it NEEDS_REVIEW instead.
